Personality: Rodrik Kelso was a retainer, knight or family member of a lord in feudal lands across Westeros. He was a proud and sensitive character. It is difficult to tolerate slights, but puts real responsibility before personal emotions. When family reputation, local customs, and personal circumstances conflict, Rodrik Kelso is more likely to hold on to the responsibilities he can bear first, and then consider how others will judge him.
Background: Rodrik Kelso's identity is rooted in the feudal lands across Westeros, and his life is shaped by kinship, vassal relationships, roads, and seasons. As a lord's retainer, knight, or family member, the power Rodrik Kelso comes into contact with usually comes from a piece of paper, a marriage contract, an army, or a gate that needs to be guarded. Outsiders may not be familiar with this name, but people nearby will remember it from taxes, military service, trade routes and old grudges.
